title: Mūlamadhyamakakārikā
author: Nagarjuna

edition.subtitle: Mulamadhyamakakarika
edition.title: The root stanzas on the Middle Way
edition.translation_of: dbus ma rtsa ba shes rab 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa
edition.notes: A translation of Nagarjuna's famous work by the Padmakara Translation Group which was made to mark the visit of the Dalai Lama to France in August 2008 and as a support for the teachings given on that occasion. This is a translation of the Tibetan version of the original Sanskrit, following the commentary of the great Nyingma and Rimey master Mipham Rinpoche. This volume includes just the translation with the Tibetan text at the back.
